About Write a Sentence

Guided writing from a model. The learner sees two model sentences, like "My name is David. I am from Vietnam.", and writes two sentences about themselves the same way. Topics are name and country, where you live, family, class day, language and work. Capitals and full stops count.

How to play

  1. Read the model sentences.
  2. Change them to be about you.
  3. Write your two sentences.

Play it as a class

Choose Write a Sentence in the Teacher Game. Students' sentences show on the projector, which is a good start for speaking.
